answer_1.quote: We propose a novel method PITA for PromptIng Task interActions to model the inter-relationships among ACTC, ARI and ARTC.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates labels for argument component type classification (ACTC), argumentative relation identification (ARI), and argumentative relation type classification (ARTC) by jointly decoding ACs and AC pairs via a generative framework.

answer_2.quote: We employ the same evaluation metrics with the previous works , including F 1 score and macro averaged score (denoted as Macro).
